title: Coach, right where you need it
summary: Version 1.3.6 brings one timely signal to Today, clearer Journey patterns, contextual coaching that keeps your place, a coach that remembers your recent sessions with Premium, and a refreshed look.
appStoreNotes: Today now leads with one timely, private signal and the easiest next action.
Journey groups your actions as Working well, Still forming, or Worth simplifying.
Ask Coach about Today or Journey evidence in an expandable sheet without leaving your place.
Review any suggested plan adjustment before confirming a change.
With Premium, your coach now remembers your recent sessions.
A refreshed app icon and launch screen, plus accessibility and stability fixes.

highlights.title: One signal for today
highlights.description: Today prioritizes the most useful local signal, from a gentle restart to the easiest next action, without requiring AI or a network connection.

highlights.title: Coach in context
highlights.description: Open the coach from the evidence you're looking at, keep your place, and preview any plan change before it's applied.
highlights.availability: 10 free check-ins monthly; unlimited with Premium.

highlights.title: A coach that remembers
highlights.description: Premium coaching sessions now pick up where your recent conversations left off.

title: Coach, right where you need it
summary: Version 1.3.5 brings one timely signal to Today, clearer Journey patterns, optional daily context, and contextual coaching that keeps your place.
appStoreNotes: Today now leads with one timely, private signal and the easiest next action.
Optionally record what helped or made a completed day harder.
Journey now groups actions as Working well, Still forming, or Worth simplifying and surfaces careful on-device discoveries.
Ask Coach about Today or Journey evidence in an expandable sheet without leaving your place.
Review any suggested plan adjustment before confirming a change.

highlights.title: One signal for today
highlights.description: Today prioritizes the most useful local signal, from a gentle restart to the easiest next vote, without requiring AI or a network connection.

highlights.title: Context without judgment
highlights.description: Optional Energy, Time, Support, Environment, and Plan fit context can reveal associations after enough saved days, never causal claims.
highlights.availability: Categories and one qualifying discovery are free; Premium includes every qualifying discovery and deeper trends.

highlights.title: Coach in context
highlights.description: Open a full coaching conversation over Today or Journey with local evidence attached, then save it to Coach history if it is useful.
highlights.availability: Weekly reviews remain free; ten other successful sessions are included each month, with unlimited sessions in Premium.

highlights.title: Preview every plan change
highlights.description: Coach can suggest one smaller schedule, clearer anchor, or easier two-minute version at a time. Nothing changes until you confirm the field-level preview.
highlights.availability: Plan guidance follows the existing coaching allowance.

title: A better time to share your experience
summary: Version 1.3.4 improves App Store discovery and makes it easier to rate Resolution Companion after you have had time to use it, without changing Premium pricing.
appStoreNotes: Added a direct App Store rating link in Settings.
Improved the timing of the optional App Store review prompt so it appears after you have more experience with the app.
Keeps the existing Monthly and Yearly Premium options unchanged.
Includes small reliability and usability improvements.

highlights.title: Rate the app when you are ready
highlights.description: A new link in Settings opens the Resolution Companion rating page directly, while the optional native review prompt waits until seven distinct completed days.
highlights.availability: Available on iPhone and iPad in version 1.3.4.

highlights.title: The same straightforward Premium choices
highlights.description: Monthly and Yearly Premium plans remain available at the existing prices, with no Lifetime tier added.
highlights.availability: $2.99 monthly or $24.99 yearly in the United States; regional pricing may vary.

title: More ways to keep moving
summary: Version 1.1 makes the daily loop faster, more personal, and easier to carry with you while keeping the app's price unchanged.
appStoreNotes: Coach openings now stream smoothly, matching the onboarding conversation.
Faster, more reliable coaching and plan creation.
Personalized reminders reflect your goals and unfinished daily actions.
Clearer Premium subscription status and plan details.
Performance, accessibility, and usability improvements.

highlights.title: Coaching without the wait
highlights.description: Coach openings appear immediately and replies stream into the conversation, grounded in your active identity and progress.
highlights.availability: Ten check-ins each month are free; Premium adds unlimited coaching and memory across sessions.

highlights.title: A reminder that knows the next step
highlights.description: After you allow notifications, one daily reminder can name your goal or unfinished action, skip rest days, and stay quiet once you finish.
highlights.availability: Choose the time that fits your routine or turn reminders off at any time.

highlights.title: Keep moving beyond the app
highlights.description: Log progress from Home and Lock Screen widgets, Siri, or optional Apple Health matches for workouts, steps, and mindful minutes.
highlights.availability: Health matching is opt-in per action, and Health data stays on your device.

highlights.title: Progress that tells a story
highlights.description: Month in Motion recaps turn your history into a share-ready story. Premium Journey insights surface patterns and useful next steps.
highlights.availability: Your personal history is analyzed locally on your device.

highlights.title: Grace when life happens
highlights.description: Seven clean action-days earn a shield that can protect your streak from a miss. Every action can still have a 120-Second Kickstart for busy days.
highlights.availability: Free holds one earned shield; Premium can hold two.

highlights.title: Private and in your control
highlights.description: Opt in to a private iCloud backup, or celebrate progress with Someone in Your Corner through a share you initiate yourself.
highlights.availability: No Resolution Companion account is required.

media.title: See the adaptive AI Coach in action
media.description: A short demonstration of coaching that remembers the plan, reflects progress, and helps adjust the next step.
transcript: I gave an AI coach my goals for a month. I went in a skeptic.
It coaches; it does not lecture. A bad week adjusts the plan.
A coach in your corner follows up on what you said.
Resolution Companion. Any day can be day one. Free to start on the App Store.
